places.name: Pește și Vin
places.evidence: Chef-owner Kenan Inci (Turkish-born, 30 yrs in Romania) profiled by Euronews RO and Daily Magazine; runs kitchen personally, competes in Arena Bucătarilor; TikTok shows him cooking on-site

places.name: La Fenice
places.area: Str. Călărașilor nr. 1, city center near Greek Church
places.evidence: Founded by Tuscan chef Alessandro Bonamici; Revista Urbania feature calls it his personal project ('o frumoasă nebunie toscană'); TripAdvisor reviews praise 'Alessandro the manager' for permanent presence; 14+ years running it

places.name: Bloom Coffee
places.evidence: Founded by Florentina Condruz who returned to Brăila after 16 years abroad; ProBraila article details her personal story — inspired by a pink café in London, built it as a hometown passion project

places.name: Grinder Coffee Shop
places.evidence: Website states 'conceived and developed by Georgel out of passion for coffee'; single-location micro-roastery with two roast profiles; no chain affiliation

places.name: R Caffee
places.evidence: TripAdvisor review: 'the most friendly owner, who gave us precious advice on what to visit in Braila' — owner present and engaging guests personally; small independent location
